title: FDA PCAC briefing: Emideltide (free base) and Emideltide acetate (July 2026)
claim: FDA evaluation: substances not well characterized; no evidence of effectiveness for chronic insomnia, narcolepsy or opioid withdrawal; immunogenicity concerns. Committee voted 7–6 (1 abstention) against 503A inclusion; final FDA action pending.
